title: Implicit Bias Injection Attacks against Text-to-Image Diffusion Models

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative evaluation using a Multi-modal Language Model (LLaVA) to classify the emotional tone (positive vs. negative) of generated images compared to originals, supplemented by human evaluation studies to measure perceived negative/positive sentiment.

Qualitative visual assessment demonstrating the injection of cultural stereotypes and context cues (e.g., features associated with African, American, Chinese, Indian populations, or developing vs. developed countries) into images generated from neutral prompts.
Qualitative visual assessment demonstrating the injection of implicit religious cues (e.g., Buddhism vs. Christianity) into images generated from neutral prompts.
Qualitative visual assessment demonstrating the subtle injection of male or female features into generated images.
